notes: County summary PDFs of the School Entry Survey, one per school year 2014-15 to 2020-21 (all grades; 2019-20 covers public schools only) plus a 2020-21 kindergarten table. Counts and percents of enrolment by certificate status: current certificate of immunization, medical and religious exemption (full, and partial with a certificate), expired, no certificate. Column order changes between years, so each file has a declared layout in ingest.R. The pattern requires a leading year so the survey packet and instruction PDFs on the page are not matched, and leaves out the school-level files (2019-2020schoolsurvey_school.pdf, 2020schoolsurvey_schoolandcounty.pdf), which are not parsed. 2020schoolsurvey_county.pdf is titled 2019-2020 but is the 2020-21 survey (page label, totals identical to the 2020-21 school-level file). Nothing has been posted since the 2020-21 tables; later years are shown only in a Caspio view.

Exemption workbooks by grade (Kindergarten, 7th, 9th) obtained by request from ADPH, one sheet per report run, 2020-21 to 2024-25: students enrolled, full medical and religious exemptions, partial exemptions while up to date, as counts and proportions. The workbook does not state whether private schools are included.
